apps.localizedDescription:
Join the global community of Ovenists in Good Pizza, Great Pizza+!
Fulfill pizza orders from customers, advance the storyline, and upgrade your restaurant to keep your doors open!
With a variety of toppings, decor, and kitchen equipment, you’ll have everything you need to compete against your pizza rivals!

How to Play
• No internet needed! Play online or offline.
• Good Pizza, Great Pizza+ is a business simulation cooking game with puzzles, stories and best of all, pizza!
• Receive a puzzling or quirky pizza order from the customer, then move to the kitchen to roll out the dough and add a variety of delicious toppings exactly as requested on the pizza!
